infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Katchimeras uses the camera so you can snap a photo of a moment and feed it into today's egg.
infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Katchimeras uses your location while the app is open so it can remember where your day happened and build gentle day maps.
infoPlist.NSLocationAlwaysAndWhenInUseUsageDescrip: Katchimeras can remember meaningful places even when the app is not open, so travel days can become landmarks in your world.
infoPlist.NSLocationAlwaysUsageDescription: Katchimeras can remember meaningful places even when the app is not open, so travel days can become landmarks in your world.
infoPlist.NSHealthShareUsageDescription: Katchimeras can read your workout routes from Apple Health when you choose to import a walk into a memory map.
infoPlist.NSSpeechRecognitionUsageDescription: Katchimeras transcribes your voice notes on your device so you can keep a written copy of the moment — the audio never leaves your phone.
